answer: Standing is a bonded ledger entry, not a claim: it needs countersignatures from distinct counterparties whose stakes are slashed for collusion, so a thousand fresh keys buy a thousand empty histories, not a thousand votes. Splitting identity pays the same bond every time, while trust accrues only along the slow velvet of verifiable trade. An atlas of these records prices strangers by their scars; a lotus that never opens earns nothing.
